name: com.kytko/products
title: Kytko
description: Digital products for solo agencies: AI prompts, n8n workflows, Notion and contract templates.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Kytko digital products for solo agencies, consultants and small operators (AI agent prompts, n8n workflows, Notion templates, Custom GPT configurations, contract templates). Optional filters: free-text query, category, maximum price in USD.

query.description: Words to match in name, description, audience or category, e.g. "n8n", "notion", "contract".

category.description: Category name, e.g. "AI Tools", "Notion Templates", "Legal Templates".

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product: description, audience, one-time price in USD, delivery, refund terms and the hosted checkout link where a person completes the payment.

product.description: Product id, slug or exact name from list_products.
